/nyi ma zla ba nub rir phyogs pa dang*/ /nyin mtshan thang cig yud tsam shugs kyis 'gro/ /skyes bu'i tshe 'gro 'di dag mtshungs par ldan/ /zhes so/ / bcu gsum pa rkyen dang gnas dus mi rtag par bstan pa ni/ yang gang gi tshe/ zas bcas 'tsho ba'i rkyen rnams phun tshogs kyang*/ /dug bzhin sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i skabs mchis na/ /mi mthun gnod mang phun tshogs cis mi 'jig /des na 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur med/ /gar 'chi cis 'chi nam 'chi cha med kyis/ / don med slu ba 'jig rten chos spongs la/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi chos bsgrub par mdzod/ / 'di ltar 'tsho ba la phan 'dogs pa'i zas kyang nad bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur pas 'phral phan par snang yang*/ phugs su gnod pa bsgrub pa nyid dang*/ nad la phan par 'dod nas 'khru sman gyis sbyangs pa las/ de nyid nad du 'gyur ba'ang yod na/ dngos su mi mthun pa'i gnod pas tshe la bar du gcod pa lta ci smos te/ 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa med pas 'chi ba 'ba' zhig bsam mo/ /de yang sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis gnas gang du 'chi ba dang*/ rkyen cis 'chi ba dang*/ dus nam gyi tshe 'chi ba'i nges pa med de/ de ring nyid kyang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng med pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du'ang spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*/ /zhes so/ / spyi don gsum pa brtson par gdams pa la gsum las/ dang po bla ma dang man ngag 'dzom dus chos bsgrub par gdams pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi lus phun sum tshogs pa rnyed pa'i dus bzang po 'dir 'khor ba las sgrol dgos par gdams pa/ 'dir ni bdag gis dal 'byor gru rnyed cing*/ /bla ma'i man ngag gru 'dzin yod bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal chu bo brgal phyir mi brtson na/ /de las bslus pa 'di na gzhan med do/ /gang gi phyir dal 'byor gyi gru bo bla ma dam pa'i chos tshul sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis srol btod pa'i lam po che dang*/

gru skya ba dag yod bzhin du brtson par mi byed na rang nyid shin tu bslus pa kho nar 'gyur ba nyid/ slob spring du/ gang zhig thub dbang rnams kyis srol btod chos kyi lam/ /rgya chen gru dang 'dra ba rnyed nas slar 'dor ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i klong 'khyil gar mkhan 'dra rnams la/ / dga' 'bas nges par de sems bslus par 'gyur ba snyam/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa ma 'bad na mi grol bar bstan pa ni/ de'i phyir snying nas nges par brtson pa la bskul ba/ gang phyir ston pas rab bsngags rin chen snod/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin yang dag thob bzhin du/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa mi 'dzin na/ /'khor ba'i btson rar rang nyid 'ching bar zad/ /rten dal ba 'di 'dra ba thob pa'i tshe rang dang gzhan la phan pa dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa de dag gtan du 'khor ba'i zhags pas 'ching bar zad de/ blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis de las bzlog nas thar pa dam pa'i chos la brtun te bsgrub par mdzod cig ces bskul ba ni/ slob spring las/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho'i mthar 'byin zhing*/ /byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yi/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba'i 'dren par chas gyur cing*/ /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*/ /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /mi yi dngos pos shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas/ /don du brnags pa gang yin de ni brtun te bsgrub/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gsum pa legs par 'doms kyang mi nyan pa la snying rje'i shugs g.yo ba ni/ da ni de skad smras kyang snying la ji mi snyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams la skyo bas rang nyid zhi bar smon zhing nam zhig na 'dren par snying rje'i shugs g.yo ba/

kye ma ji ltar rdo la 'doms pa bzhin/ / 'jig rten phal cher bsams shing skyo ba 'phel/ /bstan pas mi rtogs bshad pas go ba med/ /sang nyin 'chi yang rgyun shing rtag par 'dzin/ /'khor bas mi skyo nges 'byung rdul tsam med/ /shes bzhin nga rgyal go bzhin 'khrul pa byed/ / 'du 'dzis g.yengs la nyon mongs char 'beb pa'i/ /'gro la nam zhig bdag gis phan thogs 'gyur/ /kye ma sems can gyi gnas na gang dag ji ltar bstan yang blo gros blun pas brda dang thabs kyi rnam pa tshad med pas rjes su bzung yang dal ba don chung bar gyur te rtogs pa'i dus med cing*/ bshad pas go bar mi 'gyur ba dag dang*/ kha cig ni rang nyid sang gi tshe 'jig rten 'di'i snang ba 'dor yang bskal pa'i bar du sdod pa ltar bden par zhen pas tshe 'di'i bya ba 'ba' zhig la g.yengs/ la la dag nyon mongs pa me ltar 'bar zhing dge ba'i phyogs las ring du gyur/ gzhan dag rang gi rgyud zhe sdang gi mes bsreg cing gzhan la phrag dog pas tshul du ma'i sgo nas gshe ba dang*/ mtshang 'bru ba dang*/ ngan du sgrogs pa dang*/ skur ba 'debs pa la brtson par byed/ 'ga' zhig ni sdug bsngal du mas mnar zhing non par gyur kyang 'khor bas mi skyo la/ nges par 'byung ba'i blo rdul phra rab tsam yang rgyud la 'char ma myong*/ la la cung zad thos pa dang shes pa tsam gyis khengs shing nga rgyal bas gzhan la brnyas shing rtsod pa dang nyon mongs pa stong gi me lce phyogs bcur 'phro bas rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi dge ba'i bud shing dag bsreg cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa 'chal bas nyin mtshan du mi dge ba'i char 'bab pa de dag mthong nas res 'ga' rang byang chub la phyogs pa'i blos zhi ba'i nags su gcig pur zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa la brtson pa'i sems skye zhing*/ phal cher snying rje'i dbang du gyur bas 'di dag nam zhig na bdag kho nas thar pa la 'god par shog cig ces sems stobs chen po'i spro ba bskyed de/

/bla na med pa'i khur 'dzin pa'i smon lam du smras pa/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /sems can ji snyed yod pa kun/ /de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis/ /bde thob sdug bsngal bral bar shog /tshe thung nad kyis nyen pa dag /tshe ring nad med bde legs shing*/ /

bkres bkren dbul bas nyam thag rnams/ /bza' btung 'byor pa phun tshogs shog /rgyal po chom rkun mi rgod dang*/ /chu dang me dang g.yang sa sogs/ /gzhan gyi 'jigs pas nyen pa kun/ /'jigs bral bde ba thob par shog /gang gang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /yid la bsams pa kun grub ste/ /rtag tu dge ba'i chos spyod cing*/ /thar pa'i byang chub thob par shog /rgyal po dge bas sa skyong zhing*/ /chab srid 'jam dar che ba dang*/ /blon po'ang chos bzhin bsam 'phel zhing*/ /dmangs rnams rtag tu bde bar shog /ngan song sdug bsngal ci yod pa/ /thar nas mtho ris bde thob cing*/ /mtho ris sdug bsngal gang yod pa'ang*/ /zhi gyur bde legs 'grub par shog /sems can gyi ni khams gsum po/ /kun gyis sems ni dge gyur te/ /sdig sems yid la mi 'gyur zhing*/ / nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar shog /rgyal khams kun du lo legs shing*/ / nad med 'tshe ba kun dang bral/ /phan tshun 'khrug pa med pa dang*/ /lha yi yul bzhin skyid par shog /don mthun bsgrub rnams don grub cing*/ /nor dang 'khor g.yog grags 'dod rnams/ /ji ltar smos bzhin phun tshogs te/ / bsod nams chen po rgyas par shog /skye bo rnams kyi srid 'phel zhing*/ /rab tu byung rnams chos 'phel la/ /yon tan 'dod rnams blo 'phel zhing*/ /tshe gang bde legs 'phel bar shog /bsam gtan spyod rnams ting 'dzin dang*/ /rig dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos grub ste/ /rnam grol ye shes reg par shog /mya ngan nyam thag yi chad rnams/ /yid sos dga' ba rab rgyas shing*/ /sgyid lug zhum pas gnas pa rnams/ /brtson pas byang chub 'grub par shog /bsod nams 'byor pas rab brgyan zhing*/ /bsam gtan tshul khrims ldan pa rnams/ /nyams dogs 'jigs dang bcas pa kun/ /rtag tu bde dang mi 'bral shog /rgyal sras 'gro don spyod rnams kyi/ /sku tshe 'phrin las dpag med cing*/

/gzhan don phun sum tshogs gyur te/ /yun ring sa steng gnas par shog /gang dag bdag la brten gyur pa'i/ 'gro kun dge legs rab 'phel zhing*/ /chog shes dul ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan par shog /gang dag bstod dam smod gyur tam/ kha zer skur pa 'debs kyang rung*/ /mthong thos dran reg gyur pa rnams/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal bar shog /bdag gi ming tsam thos pa yang*/ /tshe des srid pa phyir bsnyil te/ /bde thob sdug bsngal bral gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub 'grub par shog / bdag ni deng nas dus kun du/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po ltar/ /'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur te/ /kun la phan bde 'grub par shog /phongs dang 'khor gyis log bsgrub dang*/ /don med lce 'bab gyur pa kun/ /rnam grol dge ba'i tshogs gyur te/ /rtag tu gzhan la phan brtson shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ci yod pa/ /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /bdag gi bsod nams ci yod pa/ /de kun 'gro la smin par shog /bdag gi sems stobs dge ba yis/ / 'gro kun bde thob sdug bsngal dag /rmi lam du yang mi mthong zhing*/ /bde dga'i rgya mtsho thob par shog /phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ / sangs rgyas sems can ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi bde ba'i 'tshog chas dag /bdag gis sbyor ba nyid gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ma lus su/ /bdag gi ming ni grags gyur te/ /gang la gang 'dod char 'bab cing*/ /sangs rgyas sems can mchod par shog /phyogs bcu'i 'gro drug sems can dag /rgyal bas yongs su ma bsgral ba/ /de dag bdag gis yongs bsgral te/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par shog /bde chen rnam brgyan 'od kyis mdzes byas rin chen 'byung gnas 'gro ba kun/ /sa chen nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par dge ba'i sprin gtsang las grub pa'i/ /rnga yab nor bu'i gdugs gcig 'dzin pas sa gsum gdung ba'i grib bsil zhing*/

/rnyog med chu ldan rim rgyas rgyal ba'i padma chen po 'grub par shog /lha yi bu mo nyams bag bde ba utpal dri ldan me tog phreng ba'i mgo rgyan can/ /rdzing bu'i nang ngogs chu bya rnams dang rol pa'i ge sar brtse bas ngal ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /mi snyengs gang des ches lhag gyur pa dag pa'i zhing gi mtsho chu sprul pa'i bzhad lding ba/ /nyon mongs gnod bral bsam gtan yongs gang mchog der 'gro kun bgrod par shog /dri med nyi gzhon mchog tu dmar ba'i 'od dang mtshan mo'i mig ldan rgyu skar phreng ba'i tshogs bkra ba/ /mig ldan rnams kyi bdud rtsir gyur gang tshangs pa'i gzi 'od mchog tu 'bar ba las lhag pa/ /'od ldan bdag po sems dpa' la ston mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa'i/ /snang ba rgya chen nam mkha'i khongs khyab zhing der 'gro kun ma 'bad bzhin du phyin par shog /sku gsum 'byor pa mchog tu mi dman zhi ba rdul bral sprin bral nyi zla'i lam gang yin/ /gcig dang du ma gnyis su med can bsam gyis mi khyab 'dus ma byas nyid gdod ma'i gnas/ /lhun gyis grub zhi kun du bzang po'i zhing du 'gro kun dag pa'i sems kyis ngal sos te/ / yangs dog mtho dman rgya chad phyogs lhung dmigs bsam 'das pa'i dbyings phyin shog /ces skyo ba dang ngal ba med par gzhan gyi phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas brag ri'i drung na rang dang gzhan gyi don la brtson pas gnas pa yin no/ /de ltar phan pa'i blos nye bar bskul te rang gis mthong ba bzhin mi rtag pa'i chos bstan yang cung zad mi skyo zhing rtag par 'dzin pa las blo mi ldog pa dag ni/ rdo'i gong bu mdun na gnas pa la bshad pa'am/ dud 'gro la bstan pa ltar gyur pas na/ byol song dang chos mtshungs pa nyid/ mi rtag pa'i gtam las/ bdag bzhin khyed kyang 'chi 'gyur zhes/ /mi rtag gdams ngag 'di 'dra la/ /the tshom yang ni mi 'tshal ba/ /kyi hud bdag ni byol song bzhin/

/zhes so/ / spyi don bzhi pa mjug bsdu ba la gnyis las/ dang po 'khor ba las rgal bar 'dod pas mi rtag pa bsam pa'i tshul ni/ da ni mjug bsdu bas mtha' gcig tu 'khor ba las blo ma log gi bar du bsgom zhing brtson 'grus kyi bskul ma chen por bstan pa/ 'dir ni nyes pa'i chu gter brgal 'dod cing*/ /legs pa'i yon tan rmad byung bsgrub 'dod pas/ /da lta nyid du nges par 'chi ba bsam/ /nyin mtshan kun du mi rtag 'ba' zhig bsgom/ /yang dang yang du nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed/ /'di ltar 'gro ba dang*/ 'dug pa dang*/ zab dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ gtam smra ba dang*/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs mthong ba dang*/ grong dang*/ ljongs dang*/ dgon pa na 'dug kyang rung ste/ dus thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam par bsgom te/ gang ci mthong zhing thos la dran yang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ mi rtag pa'i dpe/ mi rtag pa'i bskul mar dran par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin mtshan kun du bdag gis ni/ /'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs/ /zhes so/ /ma bsams na skyon ci yod na/ tshe 'di'i dbang kho nar song nas/ khe dang*/ grags pa dang*/ chags pa dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ le lo dang*/ gsog 'jog dang*/ sgyid lug dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ res 'ga' ba'i chos las mi 'byung la/ des ni myur du 'khor ba las mi thar te/ tha mal gyi bya ba bsgrub pa la'ang res 'ga'i dal khom gyis mi 'grub na/ thar pa'i byang chub la ni lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ brtson la rgyun ring bas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar la 'bad dgos so/ 'di ltar mar me mdzad dang*/ shākya thub pa la sogs pa 'di dag dang bdag cag gnyis dang por sems can du mnyam yang*/ khong brtson pa'i stobs bskyed pas sangs rgyas/ bdag da dung 'khor bar 'khyams/ sngon sangs rgyas grangs med byon nas mya ngan las 'das pa de dag gis kyang bdag cag gso ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur/ rang gi las kyis 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa'i tshul bsam la/

da res kyi tshe 'dis thar pa'i lam sna zin par bya dgos/ tshe 'di'ang dar cig yud tsam g.yar po 'dra bas mi rtag pa bsams la snying nas chos bsgrub pa la 'bad dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ deng nas brtson par ma byas na/ /'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas grangs med 'das gyur kyang*/ /bdag ni rang gi nyes pas de'i/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur to/ /da dung de bzhin bdag byed na/ / yang nas yang du de bzhin te/ /ngan 'gror na dang 'chi ba dang*/ /gcad dang gshags sogs myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar nyin mtshan du mi rtag cing 'chi ba 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yon tan gyi tshogs tshad med kyang re zhig bsdu na/ des ni 'di phyir phan bde'i chos 'grub cing*/ /brtson 'grus drag pos sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ / tshe 'di blos thongs bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa 'jig /mdor na legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'grub/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin thar pa dam pa'i rgyu/ /chos kun rtsa ba mi rtag blo sna bstungs/ /zhes pa ste/ 'chi nges/ da lta rang 'chi nges/ sang du'ang bsdad long e 'byung cha med snyam du dung dung skyes pa'i tshe na/ chos la brtson 'grus me ltar 'bar ba yang ngang gis 'byung bas/ 'di dang phyi mar phan pa'i lam sna zin pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i snang ba la rtag mi thub par mthong bas blo mi chags pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'khon du 'dzin pa dang*/ khro ba dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ 'tshe ba thams cad kyang ngang gis gtong zhing*/ nga rgyal dang nga bdag tu 'dzin long med pa'i bsam pa thun mong ma yin pa skye bas kun dang*/ mthun zhing yid du 'ong ba dang*/ nor dang*/ 'khor dang*/ gnyen 'dun thams cad kyang mi rtag par shes pas de dag la chags zhen mi skye zhing*/

de dag la gzhan gyi gnod pa'am/ phan pa'am/ bde sdug ci byung yang chags sdang mi skye zhing*/ de dag shi'am/ bral lam/ med kyang mi dga' ba'i mya ngan mi skye ba dang*/ gnas dang sa phyogs gang du bsdad kyang chags pa dang zhen pa'i las mi sog cing*/ 'thad pa dang*/ mi 'thad pa'i rkyen ci byung yang chags sdang dang zhen 'dzin rang mtshan pa rgyud la mi skye ba dang*/ nyin mtshan kun du dge bas 'da' zhing chos lam du 'gro bas sdom pa dang dka' thub mthar phyin pa dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa dri ma med cing nyes ltung gis mi gos pa dang*/ lam gyi chos spyod la brtson pas tshogs gnyis kyi lam brgyags gsog pa dang*/ kun spyod sdig dang ma 'dres pas bya ba gang la'ang 'gyod pa med pa dang*/ dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ nges 'byung khyad par can gsar du skye zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pas glags mi rnyed cing dkar po la mngon par dga' ba'i lhas rjes su bsrung ba dang*/ bde bar nyal/ bde bar ldang*/ bde bar 'gro/ bde bar 'chag / bde bar ldan/ bde bar tshe'i dus byas te/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa mthong ste/ bde ba'i chos thos shing*/ bde ba'i lam bsgoms te/ bde chen gyi gling du bde ba chen po'i go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur ro/ ji skad du/ 'dul ba lung las/ tshangs spyod legs par spyad pa dang*/ /lam ni legs par goms pa dag /'chi ba'i tshe na mya ngan med/ /'bar ba'i khyim las thar ba bzhin/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa thob par gsungs so/ / spyi don lnga pa skabs kyi dge ba bsngo ba ni/ da ni legs par sbyar ba'i dge ba de dag 'gro bas thob par smon pa'i tshul bstan pa/ de ltar chos tshul sprin gyi rnga sgra las/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag zab cing snyan bsgrags pas/ /'gro kun rnam g.yeng nyon mongs rtag 'dzin gyis/

/dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /ces pa ste/ phan bya'i 'od dkar bkod legs pa'i tshogs rnam par spel pa'i rgya mtsho las 'thon pa'i chu 'dzin gyi kha glal ba/ lha'i rnga sgra las ches lhag pas sbyar ba'i tshul 'bab ba gang gis/ srid par dub pa'i 'gro ba rtag par 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rnyog pa mtha' dag rab tu zhi nas/ gdod ma'i mgon po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa'i khang bzangs su bde dga'i longs spyod kyis dbugs phyin te ngal sos par shog cig ces so/ /rmi lam lta bur g.yo ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chos te snying po med/ /tshong khang 'gron 'dra lam mthun grogs po bzhin/ /mi rtag 'gyes chos can du rtogs par shog /ston ka'i sprin dang glog dang sgyu ma bzhin/ /ri gzar chu bzhin skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ste/ /mi rtag mi brtan 'gyur ba'i chos can du/ /de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par shog /gnas dang yul dang 'byor pa'i tshogs mang po/ /grags bcas che ba'i dpal mnga' gang yin pa'ang*/ /g.yo ba'i chos te nam yang yid brtan med/ /mtha' bzhi'i rang bzhin can du rtogs par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ tshe mi rtag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'i 'grel pa'o// // gsum pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi le'u la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin spyir bshad pa/ bye brag rgyas par bshad pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'i 'thad pa/ skabs kyi dge ba sngo ba'o/ /spyi don dang po sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin spyir bshad pa la brgyad las/ dang po sdug bsngal mdor bstan pa ni/ de ltar tshe mi rtag pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rjes la/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal ba nyid du bstan pa'i phyir gong du smos pa'i tshul ji skad bshad ma thag pa/ de ltar mi rtag khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ / rnam par 'gyur bas shin tu sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed nyid gsum gyis/

/grong khyer drug gi 'gro kun nyam re thag /ces smos te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ srid pa 'di ni 'gyur ba/ srid pa 'di ni mi rtag pa/ srid pa 'di ni sdug bsngal ba'o zhes gsungs te/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnam pa 'di gsum gyis 'gro ba drug po 'di dag rtsen zhing sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba yin no/ / gnyis pa sdug bsngal ba'i dpe bshad pa ni/ 'di dag gis nyon mongs par byed pa'i dpe bshad pa/ ji ltar me nang gcan gzan mi rgod khrod/ /rgyal po'i btson rar chud pa'i 'gro ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal snga phyi rgyud mas mnar bzhin du/ /da dung thar pa'i skabs med skyo ba 'phel/ /'di ltar sems can pa'i tshogs dag sdug bsngal snga ma ma sangs bzhin du phyi mas non bar gyur cing*/ bzod glags med pa ni tshad med mtha' yas pa zhig ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ phyogs rnams kun du nam mkha' dang*/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*/ /ji ltar mtha' yas de bzhin du/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtha' yas 'dod/ /ces pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba la dus thung yang*/ /bzod dka' yun ring smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa dang*/ las rnam 'byed las/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal ni bsil ba'i skabs med pas me'i 'obs lta bu'o/ /'jigs shing nyam nga bas gcan gzan khro bo dang*/ mi rgod kyi nang na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /thar ba'i go skabs dka' bas rgyal po'i khri mon lta bu'o/ /yang dang yang du 'byung bas rgya mtsho'i rlabs lta bu'o/ /bde 'gro'i srog 'joms pas dug ha la ha la lta bu'o zhes gsungs so/ /

gsum pa 'dod pas bslus pa'i dpe bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar sems can pa thams cad/ / bde thob sdug bsngal bral 'dod blo yod kyang*/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid la mngon par rgyug /mar me'i 'od la phye ma leb bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i yul la chags sred 'dzin pas bslus/ /de bzhin ri dgas bung ba nya dang glang*/ / sgra dang dri ro reg gis bslu ba ltar/ /'dod pa'i yul lnga dag gis 'gro ba bslus/ /nam yang bde med sdug bsngal gyur la ltos/ /de yang blang dor la rmongs pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu la btsan thabs su 'jug par 'dod de/ rgyu la blang dor ma byas pas bral ba'am thob par ga la nus/ 'di ltar bde ba thob par 'dod kyang de'i rgyu dge ba la ma spyad/ sdug bsngal 'dor bar 'dod kyang de'i rgyu mi dge ba nan gyis zhugs pas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun nas nyon mongs pa dug lnga'am gsum la gtso cher spyad pas kun 'byung gi mtshan nyid la rgyug cing spyod la/ de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid rnam pa sna tshogs pa can myong yang da dung bred mi shes par dang du len pa chad pas bcad pa'i rkun po lag pa bregs pa zhig gis yang brkus te mgo gcod pa'i chad pa la zhugs pa lta bu'o/ /spyod 'jug las/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang*/ /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /zhes so/ / ji ltar 'joms na/ 'dod pa'i yul lnga la chags shing zhen pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa mthu rgyas te sdug bsngal du 'jug pa ni/ phye ma leb mar me'i 'od kyi gzugs 'dod nas phyin pas tshig pa dang*/ ri dwags gling bu'i sgra la nyan pas bsad pa dang*/ bung ba sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas me tog la 'jibs pas 'byar ba'am/ kha zum nas shi ba dang*/ nya nya pa rnams kyis lcags kyu'i rtse'i zas kyi ros bslus te bsad pa dang*/ glang po che bsil ba'i reg bya 'dod nas mtshor zhugs pas shi ba lta bu ste/

do ha mdzod kyi glu las/ srid pa'i phyag rgyas 'gro ba ma lus bslus/ /zhes pa dang*/ kye ho rmongs rnams mda' snun gyis smras pa/ /nya dang phye leb glang chen bung ba dang*/ / 'dir ni ri dwags bzhin du blta bar byos/ /zhes so/ yul lnga po las nyon mongs pa skye zhing de'i dbang gis 'khor ba mtha' med par 'khyams pa 'di ni dug las kyang 'jigs par gsungs te/ slob spring las/ yul dang dug mtshungs dang po myong ba tsam na bde/ /yul dang dug mtshungs rnam smin rtsub pas mi bzad ldan/ /yul dang dug mtshungs gti mug mun pas thibs por byed/ / yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlog dka' zhing g.yo ba yin/ /yul dang dug rnams blo yis nges par brtags byas na/ /nyes na dug sla mi bzad rang bzhin yul rnams min/ /dug ni skye ba gcig la dug tu 'gyur bar zad/ / yul ni tshe rabs gzhan du'ang dug tu 'gyur bar byed/ /dug ni dug dang bsres na rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags mchog dang dug sel sman gyis gso bar rung*/ / dug ni thabs ldan spyad na mi la phan 'gyur gyis/ /dug chen yul ni nam yang de ltar ma yin no/ /zhes so/ / bzhi pa rigs drug tu brgyud mar mnar tshul ni/ srid pa 'di dag phan tshun 'khor zhing sdug bsngal ba/ /lha dang lha min dmyal ba yi dgas mi/ /byol song rigs drug zo chun rgyud mo bzhin/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ / ji skad du/ rin chen phreng ba las/ lam gsum thog mtha' dbus med par/ /'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor mgal me yi/ /'khor lo lta bur phan tshun du/ /rgyu can 'di ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / lnga pa dgra zun ma nges pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar 'khor ba na 'khor dus kyi/ tshe rabs bgrangs tshe sems can re res kyang*/ /mdza' bshes dgra dang bar ma'i khur khyer nas/ /bde sdug phan gnod sbyin pa grangs mtha' yas/ /pha nyid mar gyur ma nyid sring mo nyid/

/de nyid bur gyur nges pa ma mchis shing*/ /mdza' bo dgrar gyur pa yang thug pa med/ /'di ltar thog ma med pa'i tshe rabs su sems can gang yang rung ba gcig gis sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi pha la sogs pa byas shing*/ de dag gis kyang de'i pha dang ma dang mdza' bshes byas pa'i grangs gzhal bar mi nus te/ bshes spring las/ des pa 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi ba dang*/ /na dang rga sogs sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba la ni skyo mdzod cing*/ /de yi nyes pa'i shas kyang mkhyen par mdzod/ /pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgrar gyur pa yang bshes nyid dag /bzlog pa nyid du mchis pas de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes so/ / drug pa skye ba grangs med par sdug bsngal ba'i tshul ni/ gzhan yang*/ 'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i las bsams na/ skyo ba bas kyang shin tu skyo ba 'phel/ /rang nyid grog sbur gyur pa'i lus rnams kun/ /gcig tu bsdoms te phung por byar yod na/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi pas ches mtho zhing*/ /ngus pa'i mchi ma rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag / sems dmyal yi dgas gyur tshe 'thungs gyur pa'i/ /zangs zhun rnag khrag mi gtsang khu ba rnams/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i chu klung char mi phod/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dpag yas nam mkha' 'dra/ /'dod phyir mgo dang yan lag bcad pa'i grangs/ /'jig rten rdul phran snyed kyis char mi phod/ /ji skad du/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ dge slong dag srid pa'i khams la skyo bar gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba na 'khor ba gang gi tshe/ grog sbur du skyes te dor ba'i lus kyang gcig tu bsdoms te phung por byas na ri'i rgyal po ri rab bas kyang ches thom zhing*/ ngus pa'i mchi ma'ang rgya mtsho bzhi'i chu las lhag go /dmyal ba dang yi dwags su gyur pa de'i tshe lan grangs med dpag tu med pa zhig 'thungs pa'i zangs zhun khol ma dang*/

khrag dang*/ chu ser dang*/ rnag dang*/ ngar snabs kyang 'di ltar gling bzhi'i nang nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen po bzhi bas mang zhing*/ 'dod pa dag gi phyir mgo dang*/ mig dang*/ yan lag dang*/ nying lag bcad pa'ang gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las 'das pa'i grangs dang mnyam par gyur to/ /zhes pa dang*/ bshes spring du/ re res rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag pa yi/ /'o ma 'thungs te da dung so so yi/ /skye bo'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'khor ba pas/ /de bas ches mang snyed cig btung 'tshal lo/ /re re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni/ /lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das gyur te/ /ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ /ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis ldang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / bdun pa tshangs sogs bde 'bras thob kyang mthar sdug bsngal ba'i tshul ni/ gzhan yang 'khor ba na spyod pa de'i tshe/ byol song grul bum gnod sbyin lto 'phye sogs/ /'gro ba'i khams gyur bde sdug grangs med myong*/ /tshangs dang brgya byin bsam gtan gzugs med dang*/ /sa gzhi rin chen bdun gyis legs skyong ba'i/ /mi dbang dpal sde phun tshogs de thob kyang*/ /ngan 'gror ltung bas ches cher sdug bsngal lo/ /yang 'di ltar 'khor ba na brgyud pa de'i tshe sa dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ gling dang*/ nam mkha'i khams kyi yul thams cad du'ang ma phyin pa med cing*/ lha dang klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ grul bum dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba yang lan grangs med pa byas te/ de dag gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal yang ma myong ba med la/ slar yang ngan song du 'khor zhing sdug bsngal ba 'di ni shin tu skyo ba'i gnas te/ slob spring du/ 'gro bar lan brgyar ma song 'gro de gang zhig yod/ /sngon chad lan mang ma myong bde ba de gang zhig

/rnga yab dkar mdzes lta bu'i dpal gang ma thob pa/ /de yang gang zhig yod na 'on kyang 'dod chags 'phel/ /gang gi gling bar ma gnas chu bo de yod min/ /yul phyogs gang du gnas ma bcas pa'i gnas de med/ /gang du ma son nam mkha'i phyogs de'ang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang 'dod chags dgang dka' 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /sngon chad lan mang ma myong sdug bsngal de yod min/ /'gro bar gang gis tshim gyur 'dod pa de dag med/ /gang gi ltor ma nyal ba'i sems can de med na/ /'on kyang ji ltar 'khor ba can la chags bral med/ /skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'gro ba rgya chen 'dir/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dag gis lan mang 'gre ldog pas/ /'gro bar gnyen ma gyur pa'i skye bo de gang med/ /ces so/ / brgyad pa 'gyur pa'i chos nyid kyis sdug bsngal tshul ni/ de ltar 'khor bar kha brgyud pa na skyo bar bya ba gzhan yang bsam par 'os pa ni/ tshe 'dir 'byor pa mtha' yas nyams dga' ba/ /mthon po'i rang bzhin can rnams tshe 'phos nas/ /dbul bas nyam thag yang bran nyid gyur pa/ /rmi lam 'byor pa gnyid sad med pa bzhin/ /bde sdug mi rtag 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /shin tu bsams na ches cher skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas grong khyer gsum gyi sems can rnams/ / 'khor ba'i bde la chags med byang chub bsgrubs/ /zhes 'doms pa ste/ 'di ltar lha'i dbang po dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang*/ mi dang bcas pa'i bde ba thob pa yang*/ sngon gyi las dge ba'i 'bras bu de zad pa tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ lha dang*/ mi phal pa nas 'bras bu che ba'i bar bsam gtan gyi lha dang*/ gzugs med pa'i lha yang 'chi 'pho zhing ngan song la sogs par sngon gyi las kyi mthus bde sdug du ma myong dgos te/ mdo sde mngon par 'byung ba las/ gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog nas/ /'dren pa seng ge'i skyes bu 'chi 'pho ste/

/lha rnams dag la tshig tu smra ba ni/ /bag med mtha' dag rnam par spongs zhes smra/ /lha yi dga' ba rnam mang ji snyed pa/ /de kun las dge'i rgyu las byung bas na/ /de lta bas na byas pa gzo bar gyis/ /dge ba bsags pa 'dir ni zad gyur te/ / gang du mi bde'i sdug bsngal myong gyur nas/ /ngan song dag tu ltung bar gyur ta re/ /zhes so/ /tshul 'di rgya cher rol pa dang 'dul ba lung las kyang 'byung ngo*/ /de'ang rmi lam gyi nor dang khang khyim dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa lha dang mi'i dbang po byed pa zhig rmis pa gnyid las sad pa na med pa ji lta bar 'gyur ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa/ /de de dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /'das pa thams cad mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshe rabs 'phos pa na yang 'gyur te/ bshes spring las/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni/ /las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng ltung*/ / 'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang*/ /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /mtho ris bu mo'i nu ma rked pa la/ /reg pa'i bde ba yun ring lon nas slar/ /dmyal ba 'thag gcod dbad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /rkang pa'i reg pas nems par bde bzod pa/ /lhun po'i spo la yun ring gnas nas ni/ /slar yang me mur ro myags rgyu ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad bog mnyam bgyid 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris bu mo 'brongs shing dga' ba dang*/ /rnam par mdzes tshal son pa brtses nas slar/ /'dab ma ral gri 'dra tshal nags rnams kyis/ /rkang lag rna ba sna gcod thob par 'gyur/ /dal gyis 'bab pa lha yi bu mo ni/ /gdong mdzes gser gyi padma ldan zhugs nas/ /slar yang dmyal ba'i chu bo rab med par/ /tsha sgo bzod brlag chu tshan 'jug 'tshal lo/ /lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang*/ /tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/

/mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yis/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad par bsten 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus kyi/ /'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te/ /slar yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur nas/ /rang gi lag pa brkyang pa'ang mthong mi 'gyur/ /de ltar nongs par 'gyur 'tshal bsod nams ni/ /rnam gsum mar me'i snang ba rab bzhes shig /gcig tu nyi ma zla bas mi brdzi ba'i/ /mun nag mtha' yas nang du 'jug 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /de bas na 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa'o/ khams gsum ni/ snang ba dang*/ phyed snang ba dang*/ mi snang ba'i grong khyer gsum ste/ rags pa dang*/ dngas pa dang*/ mi snang ba'i phyir na/ 'di dag gi bde ba cung zad la ma chags bar bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrubs shig ces 'doms te/ de'ang dge ba bsgrub pa la dal khom med par brtson dgos pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de dag phyir zlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang*/ /yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes so/ /spyi don gnyis pa bye brag rgyas par bshad pa la/ 'khrul gzhi/ 'khrul tshul/ dbye ba gsum gyi/ 'khrul gzhi la yang gnyis te/ dang po khams gsum 'khrul ba'i rten du bstan pa ni/ de'ang sdug bsngal gang ci yod pa dag gi rten gzhi ni nang gi khams gsum yin no zhes bshad pa/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dod gzugs gzugs med de/ /snang dang phyed snang mi snang grong khyer na/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed gsum gyis gdungs/ /sems dang yid dang rnam shes mched pa yis/ /yul rnams bde sdug 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad/ /de la lus ni rags pa'i dngos po 'dus pa'i phyir snang ba'i grong khyer dang*/ ngag ni brag ca ltar med bzhin du snang bas phyed snang ba'i grong khyer dang*/ yid ni sgo lnga'i rnam par med pas shin tu dngos po med pa'i phyir mi snang ba grong khyer te/

'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang/ gzugs med pa zhes btags so/ / gang las na/ dgongs 'dus las/ lus rags pa 'dod pa'i khams dang*/ ngag phra ba gzugs kyi khams dang*/ yid ches phra ba gzugs med pa'i khams te/ grong khyer de gsum na khye'u snang ba dam pa zhes bya ba gnas so zhes rang byung gi ye shes la bshad do/ /de ltar sgo gsum po'i steng du sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung ba yang*/ kun nas rtog pa'i rkyen gyis shar te gcig nas gcig tu 'khrul zhing myong ba'o/ /ji ltar shar na tshogs drug gi yul la rnam shes drug dbang po'i sgo so so las 'thon te/ yul 'dzin pas bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang bar ma gsum gang rung shes pa'i rgyun la zhen to/ /de la gzugs la sogs pa'i rnam pa so sor shar ba'i cha ni rnam par shes pa'o/ / yul dang por rags pa spyi'i rnam par lam ste rig pa ni sems so/ /de'i khyad par la dpyod cing chags pa dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ gti mug gsum gang rung du rgyun mthud pa'i sems byung la yid ces bya ba skabs 'di brjod de/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ de la yul snang ba ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /dang por rtog pa ni sems

so/ /phyi nas de'i khyad par la dpyod pa ni sems las byung ba ste yid do/ /'di gsum ni mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ kun du 'gro ba'i bdag nyid du gnas so zhes so/ /de'ang sems yod pas na sems las byung ba yang de'i rjes su mtshungs ldan te grogs kyi tshul du sems kyi kun 'gror yod la/ sems las byung ba la'ang sems kyis khyab par 'brel pa grub pas mtshungs par ldan zhing grogs can gyi tshul du sems byung gi kun 'gror yang gnas te/ yul rig pas 'jal ba na dang por spyi'am ngo bo la dmigs pa'i cha nas sems zhes pa dang*/ de nas cha shas bye brag 'jal bas sems las byung ba zhes tha snyad so sor btags kyang*/ don la yul rig cing dpyod pa nyid kho na las gzhan med de/ rin chen phreng ba las/ gang gi sems mthong 'gyur zhe na/ /tha snyad du ni brjod pa ste/ /sems byung med par sems mi 'byung*/ /don med lhan cig mi 'dod do/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa dang*/ gnas lugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshe yul rig pas snang yul so sor 'jal yang sems yid rnam par shes pa zhes mi ste/ gzung ba yul la 'dzin pa shes pas gnyis snang du 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa las/ 'gro bas sems yid rnam shes su/ /gzung 'dzin goms pas rnam brtags pa/ /mi rtog ye shes de med phyir/ /don mthong blo ni ye shes mchog /ces pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang yang bral la ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas kyang mi 'dor pa ste/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o zhes so/ /de'ang gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i rnam pa phyi rol na ci shar ba de dang 'dra rung blos rig pas rnam par shes pa zhes bya'o/ /yang na yul gyi rnam pa dang 'dra ba'i blos bskyed pas na rnam par shes pa zhes bya'o/ /yul shes dus dang por 'di'o zhes rig pa'i cha nas sems zhes bya'o/

/de'i khyad par la dpyod pas rgyun 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir yid ces bya'o/ /de'ang yul snang la 'jal byed kyi shes pa skad cig gis wal gyis sgo so so la thon nas dpyod dus/ bde bar zhen na 'dod chags dang*/ sdug bsngal du zhen na zhe sdang dang*/ bde sdug gnyis ka ma yin par 'di'o zhes zhen na gti mug ste/ dper na sngon 'dris pa'i bzang mo mthong ba dang*/ bdag pham par byas pa'i dgra bo mthong ba dang*/ rtsig pa dang*/ chu dang*/ lam po che dang*/ ljon shing dang skye bo phal pa rnams dga' gdung med par mthong dus bzhin no/ /ji skad du/ 'dul ba lung las/ skye bo mdza' ba mthong na chags pa dang*/ /gnod pa mngon par bsgrub la sdang ba'i blo/ /bar ma rnams la gti mug rnam 'phel bas/ khyod kyi dbang po'i sgo rnams bsdam par gyis/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ / gnyis pa tshogs brgyad 'khrul pa'i gzhi mar bstan pa ni/ da ni de dag gi 'char gzhi dang dbye ba rgyas par ston te/ 'di ltar/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid dang sgo lnga'i shes/ / rim bzhin mched pa mched pa'i rim pa yin/ /de las srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'byung*/ /rtsa ba ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa can/ /yul dang don dang sems su bag chags pas/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pas 'khor ba grub/ /de la cha shas rnam par dbye na/ yul so so la 'char ba'i shes pa dag gi rang dus na/ sal gyis rnam dbye med par rig pa gang yin pa'i sems la kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas der 'dzin pa'i blo zhib tshags dang che long la sogs pas yul gyi rnam par dpyod pa ni yid yin te/ 'jam dpal ye shes rgyan gyi mdo las/ sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ /ngar 'dzin pa ni yid yin no/ /zhes so/ mig la brten nas gzugs mthong ba'i mthong cha gang yin pa de ni mig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ / de bzhin du rna ba la brten nas sgra dang*/ sna la brten nas dri dang*/

lce la brten nas ro dang*/ lus la brten nas reg bya reg pa'i shes pa'i cha ni de dag gi rnam par shes pa ste lnga'o/ /snga ma'i cha las phyi ma'i shes pa skye bas skye mched ces bya ba dang*/ de dag gi yul dang shes pa rkyen rnams yod par dpag tu med pas na mang zhing rgya che la so so'i cha mi 'dor bas na khams zhes bya'o/ /yul las yul can gyi blo brten pa ltar 'char ba nyid dang*/ snga ma las phyi ma 'brel bar 'byung ba dang*/ chos can dang chos nyid du gyur pas na rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba dang*/ yul dang yul can gyi blo gnyis 'dus pa'i tshe bde ba la sogs pa'i rnam par tshor zhing rig pa'i cha nas 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba zhes bya'o/ /de dag la sogs pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag dpag tu med do/ mdor bsdu na/ yul/ dbang po/ yid la byed pa gsum tshogs pa las skyes pa'i dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba'i las thams cad ni mi dge ba'o/ /bzod pa la sogs pa dug gsum dang bral bar skyes pa gang yin pa de ni dge ba chen po'o/ /lam shes rab snying rjes ma zin pa'i dge ba bcu lta bu ni dge ba dman pa ste/ gti mug gi sa pas bsdus pa'i phyir 'khor ba'i bde 'bras bskyed nas zad par 'gyur bas bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba zhes bya'o/ /lam gyis zin phan chad byang chub kyi rgyu byed pas thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba zhes bya'o/ /dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i mi dge bas ni ngan 'gro dang sdug bsngal ci yod pa de dag gi rgyu byed la/ bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba ni mngon par mtho ba lha dang mi'i bde ba'i dpal 'dzin cing*/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge bas ni gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang*/ mthar thug nges par legs pa gnyis ka'i rgyu byed do/ /ji skad du/ rin chen phreng ba las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dag /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/

/ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las de dge ba yin/ / mi dge las ni sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*/ /skye ba kun du bde ba dag /ces so/ /de'ang phyi rol ltar snang ba'i dngos po rmi lam dang 'dra ba rnams la gzhan no zhes gzung bas yul du bag chags te dag ma dag rnam pa sna tshogs par snang zhing 'khrul pa'i gnas su gyur/ lus 'byung ba las bskyed pa yang nang gi de kho na nyid ma shes pa'i rkyen gyis don du bag chags te/ phung po dang khams dang*/ skye mched la sogs pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ des bskyed pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi cha 'dzin pas 'khrul pa'i rten du gyur/ rang byung gi ye shes 'od gsal ba la ngo bo stong*/ rang bzhin gsal/ gdangs sna tshogs su 'char sgo ma 'gags pa la gzung 'dzin rang mtshan du zhen pas rig pa sems su bag chags te dug lnga dug gsum du 'char zhing*/ 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa can du gyur pas 'khor ba 'khrul pa'i snang ba gzugs brnyan nam rmi lam khung ngam skra shad 'dzag pa ltar med la snang ba bden bden 'dra ba 'di byung ba yin no/ /de'ang 'dzin byed nga dang*/ gzung yul nga yir 'dzin pa ste khang khyim la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo bzhin no/ / 'khrul tshul la gnyis kyi/ dang po rang ngo shes ma shes kyis 'khrul grol du bstan pa ni/ da ni 'khrul gzhi dang 'khrul tshul rgyas par ston te/ 'di ltar/ sems nyid 'gyur med yongs grub chos sku yang*/ /ma rig 'dzin pas kun brtags goms pa yis/ /ma dag gzhan dbang ltar snang 'khrul pa can/ /yul don bdag gzhan gnyis snang gnyis su gzung*/ /de las sdug bsngal dpag med lhun gyis grub/ / nam zhig 'gyur med sems nyid don rtogs nas/ /phyin ci ma log yongs grub lam bsgoms pas/ /dag pa gzhan dbang zhing du legs son te/ /srid pa'i grong las ngal gso byed par 'gyur/

/de la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung las grub pa'i mtha' chen po gsum gsungs te/ kun du brtags pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dbang dang*/ yongs su grub pa'o/ /kun brtags pa de yang gnyis te/ mtshan nyid chad pa dang*/ rnam grangs pa'o/ /de la mtshan nyid chad pa ni gang gi ngor yang med la rtog pas btags pa ste/ ri bong gi rwa dang*/ bdag ces bya ba lta bu'o/ /der yang ma zad de grub pa'i mtha' ngan pa dang*/ gang dang gang gi ming dang don zhes blos bkod pa thams cad do/ /de yang ji ltar zhe na/ 'ga' zhig seng ge zhes btags pa'i ming de nyid lus kyi gnas kun du btsal yang mi rnyed pa dang*/ don gyi rnam pa 'di zhes bkod kyang blos rlom pa tsam las rang mtshan brjod pa ngag dang dran pa sems kyi dngos yul du med du me'i sgra don bzhin no/ /rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags ni/ re zhig 'khrul ngo na snod bcud bde sdug phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs su shar ba 'di rnams so/ /de yang don du ma grub la sems kyi 'khrul ngor snang ba rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags zhes bya'o/ /de thams cad kyang gshis la med bzhin du 'khrul ngor snang zhing sgro btags pas kun brtags zhes bya ste/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las/ kun du brtags pa rnams de ni/ /med bzhin 'khrul pa'i blos bskyed do/ /zhes so/ /gzhan gyi dbang la'ang gnyis te/ ma dag pa dang*/ dag pa gzhan gyi dbang ngo*/ /de la ma dag pa gzhan gyi dbang ni/ bag chags brtas pa las skyes pa'i sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa snod bcud kyi rnam pa ma dag pa ltar dbang po'i sgo so so la shar ba'i snang ba 'khrul pa ba rnams so/ / dag pa gzhan dbang ni/ dag pa'i zhing dang sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i yul la snang ba'i zhing khams dang*/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ dang ba 'od kyi gzhal yas khang du shar ba'i snang ba rnams so/ /de la 'dir kha cig dag rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung las gzhan dbang mi 'thad de thams cad rang gi snang ba kho nar 'dus pa'i phyir zhes rtsod pa'ang rigs par ma mthong ste 'di ltar/

rang gi shes pa las bag chags pa'i cha nas rang du 'jog pa'ang ma yinate/ me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gyi rnam pa'i rkyen gyis chags na'ang bzhin ma yin pa bzhin no/ thams cad rang gi snang ba kho nar 'dus zhes pa'ang dpyad dgos te/ sems la snang ba tsam du 'dus sam/ snang ba sems yin par 'dus grang*/ dang po ltar na snang ba tsam gyi dus na 'dus pa dang ma 'dus pa'i dpyad ra med pas 'dus zhes pa'ang tshig tsam du bas te don gyi rnam pa phyir lus pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na 'di la 'thad pa ci yod/ sems las byung ba'i phyir sems yin no zhe na/ bud med las byung ba'i bu yang bud med du 'gyur te bud med ma yin pa dang*/ lus las byung ba'i mi gtsang ba yang lus su thal ba las ma yin par mngon sum na gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang sems la snang bas sems yin no zhe na'ang*/ gzugs kyang mig shes su thal te mig shes la snang ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can phyin ci log la sngon du sangs rgyas snang ba yang sems can de'i sems su thal lo/ /'dod na ni sems can phyin ci log gi blo can sangs rgyas par thal ba'i skyon dang*/ sangs rgyas la sems can snang bas yang na sems can gyi khams ril sangs rgyas su 'gyur la/ yang na sangs rgyas dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba de yang sems can du thal ba'i nyes pa 'di ni nam yang spong ba ma yin no/ /sems med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ sems su 'dod do zhe na'ang*/ dngos rgyu dang dngos 'bras kyang gcig tu 'gyur te med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ dgra dang bdag gi khong khro'ang gcig tu 'gyur te/ dgra med na des bskyed pa'i khro ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang sems kyis byas pa'i phyir sems yin no zhes pa'ang mi rigs te/ ri mo'i rnam pa'ang ri mo mkhan du 'gyur te ri mo mkhan gyis byas pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na phyi rol gyi sa rdo ri brag sems su 'dod par ga la 'thad/

sems kyi bag chags las skyes pa'i 'khrul snang yin du chug gal te de ltar ma yin na skye bo brgyas bum pa gcig la bltas dus ril gyis mthong ba'i bum pa de de rnams kyi shes par 'gyur bas 'gro ba kun shes pa gcig par 'gyur ro/ /'dod na gcig sangs rgyas pa na kun sangs rgyas pa dang*/ gcig ngan song du song dus kun 'gro bar rigs so/ /de dag gi ltar na 'jig rten na yang khyod dam nga lta bu'i sems can gcig las med par thal te ril ji ltar snang ba kun rang gi sems las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na shākya thub pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas gcig las gzhan mi 'thad de/ des gzigs pa'i yul thams cad de'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na ni kho bo cag 'dug pas gsal ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i gzhung 'dzin pa ni deng sang shin tu mang bar snang ste/ theg pa chen po'i don la rab tu rmongs par zad do/ /lus che padma'i dra bas g.yogs/ /me tog rna rgyan dang ldan zhing*/ /gser gyi gdong rgyan lhag ge ba/ /glang chen bsgyings pa kho nar zad/ /ces bya ba yin no/ /'di ltar snang ba dag gang yin zhe na/ sems tsam rnam brdzun dri med pas khas blangs pa ltar rigs su chug kyang*/ de'i gzhung las/ 'di ltar rang rang la snang ba dag rang rang gi sems yin yang*/ snang yul sems ma yin te/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa mang po pa las/ ji ltar snang ba sems snyed de/ /snang ba'i yul nyid de lta min/ /thog ma med dus bag chags can/ /'khrul pas skra shad 'dzings pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar yin te/ snang ba dang snang yul ma phyed pa yin no/ de'ang snang yul ri las/ ri'o snyam du gzhan ltar blos wal gyis 'dzin pa sems kyi snang ba mig gi dbang po la brten nas skye'o/ /de yang rang gis gang du phyin pa'i yul du rang gi sems kyis 'dzin pa'i cha ni rang gi snang ba ste/ de nas gzhan du phyin dus snang yul rjes su mi 'brang yang*/

sngar mig shes dbang po'i mngon sum la snang ba'i bag chags 'dzin byed/ don spyi yid kyi yul med pa gsal snang yid kyi dbang po la sal gyis snang ngo*/ / des na yid kyis gzhal ba'i snang ba dang*/ de 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhan rnams kyi snang ba dang*/ de 'dzin pa thams cad sems yin yang*/ yid kyi'ang gang dmigs skye yul ni snang yul 'jog byed de dang*/ sgo lnga'i yul thams cad thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis med bzhin du snang ba skra shad 'dzings pa 'bab pa lta bu'o/ /de lta na gnyis su 'gyur te/ snang yul dang snang ba tha dad du grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ khyed rang la'ang gnyis su 'gyur te snang ba'i sems phyi na yod pa dang*/ 'dzin byed kyi sems nang na 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ / de gnyis ka'ang sems su gcig pas gnyis zhes brjod kyang rigs mthun du gcig go zhe na/ 'dir yang bag chags 'khrul pa'i rkyen gyis snang yul dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i nges pa'i snang ba gnyis med bzhin snang ba bag chags 'khrul ba pa'i rnam par tha snyad du tha mi dad la/ de gnyis don la med pas gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin du grub pa yin no/ kho bo cag dbu ma pa ni/ dpyad na snang yulagyi dngos po sems ma yin par ma zad/ snang ba'ang sems su mi 'dod de/ nang gi sems phyir med la phyi'i snang ba dbang po so so la shar ba blos nang du dpyad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te snang ba phyir lus na skyes bu rnam shes gnyis pa dus gcig la srid pa'am/ rang nyid bems por 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon du ma yod do/ /des na snang mi snang du 'dzin pa ni sems yin yang snang ba sems su mi 'grub ste/ rnga sgra yin min nyan shes kyis gzung yang*/ nyan shes rnga sgrar mi 'grub pa bzhin no/ /mdor na rang gi sems phyir 'phro ba 'dra yang phyir ma song ba dang phyi'i rnam pa nang du snang ba'i phyir/ phyi'i snang ba nang gi sems gtan nas ma yin no/

/gang yin na med la snang ba'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dkar dmar sna tshogs su shar ba 'di dag bad kan mig nad can la skra shad 'dzag par snang ba ltar/ phyi nang bar gsum gang na'ang med la snang bas rang bzhin med pa'am/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa zhes bya'o/ /sems su grub pa dang sems las gzhan du grub pa gnyis ka rang bden zhen las ma grol bas khyad med pa kho na'o/ /phyi rol yul gyi dngos po shes pa ma yin pa khas len pas nyan thos bye brag pa dang mtshungs so zhe na mi mtshungs te/ bye brag pas yul bems po rang mtshan du grub par khas blangs kyi/ kho bo cag ni bag chags 'khrul snang rmi lam lta bu med bzhin sems la snang bar brjod pa yin no/ /tshul 'di dbu ma pa dag gis kyang dgag tu med cing 'thad pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ci dbu ma thal 'gyur pas gang khas blangs pa 'gog mod ce na/ 'di ltar snang tsam dgag pa ma yin gyi/ bden par zhen pa yod na 'gog ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'di ltar snang nyid dgag min gyi/ /bden par rtog pa bzlog bya yin/ zhes gsungs la/ sems tsam rnam bden pas rnam pa sems su khas blangs pa dang*/ rnam bden brdzun gnyis kas don dam par rang rig grub par 'dod pa bkag gi /bag chags 'khrul pa'i snang ba med bzhin shar ba dang*/ grub pa'i rnam gzhag don la 'jug pa rnams ga la 'gog ste/ kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag byed dus gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar phyi gzhan dbang dang*/ sems rig pa snga ma las phyi ma skye ba ltar snang ba'ang don gzhan snga ma la ltos pas gzhan dbang zhes nang la sbyor ba de'ang dpyad dgos te/ snga phyi ltar snang bas 'dogs na ming du zad don la rang yin pas mthun la/ gzhan du tha dad par 'dod na rig pa yin pas gzhan mtshan nyid par ma grub pas khas blangs pa 'gal ba ni legs pa ma yin no/ ji skad du/ snga ma las/ 'di ltar sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /gzhan du rnam pa 'dra ba'i phyir/

/gzung 'dzin ma dag gzhan gyi dbang*/ /dag pa'ang gzhan gyi dbang zhes pa/ /dbang du 'gyur pa dag min yang*/ /gzhan ltar snang ba de bshad do/ /zhes so/ yongs su grub pa la'ang*/ 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'o/ de la 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gang gi tshe'ang rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos nyid rang chas su ldan pa'i stong pa ste/ sngon dang phyis la khyad par med par gnas pa 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs su grub ces bya ba gshis kyi gnas lugs so/ /'di'i dbang du byas te stong pa'ang rnam pa gsum du bzhag go /rang gis stong pa dang*/ gzhan gyis stong pa dang*/ gnyis kas stong ba'o/ /rang gis stong pa ni med bzhin snang ba chu'i zla ba lta bu rang gi mtshan nyid spangs pa dang*/ rang gzhan du dbye ba'i cha shas med kyang lhun gyis grub pa'i chos mi 'dor bas btags par rang gi ngo bos stong pa gnyis

so/ /gzhan gyis stong pa'ang*/ mi ldan pa gzhan gyis stong pa dang rnam grangs gzhan gyis stong pa'o/ /gnyis kas stong pa la'ang*/ gnyis bcas rnam grangs pas stong pa dang sgra don rang mtshan pas stong pa'o/ /de la sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal ba snying po'i khams kyi rang bzhin 'di ni skyon gyi dngos po mtha' dag gis stong la/ yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa'i cha nas skyon yon grub bsal las 'das pa'o/ /'khrul snang dri ma'i chos dkar dmar sna tshogs su shar ba dang*/ kun du rtog pa'am rnam shes tshogs brgyad po 'di dag ni gshis la med pas rang gi ngo bos kyang stong la/ ka ba dang bum pa ltar rnam grangs pas kyang stong zhing skyon gyi cha dang ldan pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa'i cha nas skyon yon grub bsal las 'das pa'o/ /lam rnams kyang rang gi ngo bos stong pa dang*/ yon tan dang skyon gyi cha 'ga' zhig ldan pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa'i cha nas skyon yon las 'das pa'o/ /dag pa mthar thug pa'i tshe nyes pa'i skyon bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gis stong pa dang*/ khams kyi yon tan ci yod pa mthar thug pa mngon du gyur pas mi stong pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i cha nas skyon yon grub bsal las 'das pa'o/ /mdor bsdu na/ rang gis stong pa ni chos gang dang gang yin pa de'i rang bzhin bden pa med pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis las/ mtshan nyid rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni gang du'ang mtshan nyid chad pa ri bong gi rwa dang*/ 'khrul ngor snang la gshis sam don la med pa chu zla lta bu'i stong pa'o/ /brtags pas rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni ming tshig yi ger btags pa rnams te blos bkod pa tsam las yul de'i rang mtshan pa med pa bu chung la seng ger btags pa'i ming gi sgra seng ge /don g.yu ral dang bcas pa ste ming gi sgra don bu chung gi lus gang na'ang med mod/ go byed kyi ming las go bya'i don mtshon nus pas stong yang don byed nus pa la btags pa thams cad do/

/gzhan gyis stong pa ni chos de la chos gzhan med pa'i cha nas btags pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis las/ mi ldan pa gzhan gyis stong pa ni/ nyi ma la mun pa mi ldan pa'am/ ka ba dang*/ snam bu la sogs pa nyi ma la med pa'i chos kyi don rang mtshan pa gzhan thams cad do/ /rnam grangs gzhan gyis stong pa ni nyi ma dang*/ 'od byed pa dang*/ rta bdun zhes pa rnam grangs spyir btags/ khams dang dpe bsdu'i bye brag ji ltar brjod pa thams cad kyis nyi ma'i don rang mtshan la ma reg pas na stong pa'o/ /gnyis kas stong pa ni chos gang la gnyis su med pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis las/ rnam grangs btags pa ba dang*/ don rang mtshan pa'o/ /btags pa pa ni 'khor bar 'khrul pa zhes btags pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa thams cad kyi khams gsum rang mtshan pas stong ste ming du tha snyad pa'i blos bkod pa'i phyir ro/ /rang mtshan pas stong pa'ang*/ rang mtshan med pas gnyis bcas med pa mo gsham bu'am smig rgyu'i chu lta bu dang*/ rang bzhin bden par med kyang snang ba ma 'gags par gsal ba dag pa gzhan dbang lta bu'i stong pa'o/ /de ltar ngo bo gsum dbye na drug gis stong pa de dag kyang brjod byas stong pa ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ rjod byed rnam grangs pas stong pa blo las 'das pa'i tshul gnyis su 'du bas na chos thams cad kyis stong pa yang tshul de ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /stong chad med par smra ba de dag gis ni stong pa'i tshul mi shes pas phyi rol pa'i rgyang 'phen pa dag dang chos mthun la/ 'di ni stong 'di ni mi stong zhes pa'i stong pa ni nye tshe ba'i stong pa ste rtag par lta ba rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang chos mthun pas rtag chad kyi mthar lhung ba yin pas bsten par mi bya ba kho na'o/ /phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub ni thar pa dam pa'i lam ste gnas lug ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas snang ba'i cha ma dor bas kun rdzob tu bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing*/

stong pa'i rang bzhin la bsam te don dam par ye shes kyi tshogs gcig dang du ma bral ba'i chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu la nan tan byed do/ / yang snga ma las/ phyin ci ma log ces bshad pa/ /lam gyi bden pas yang dag bsdus/ /zhes so/ mdor bsdu na/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba 'gyur ba med pa'i de kho na nyid khong du chud cing*/ chos thams cad kun brtags pa tsam du stong par rtogs nas/ lam bsgoms na ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang kun brtags pa'i blo dang bcas pa gnas gyur pa'am dag nas/ gdod ma'i ngang du phyin te sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i zhing khams dag pa la mnga' dbang rdzogs par 'gyur pa ni bstan pa dam pa'i chos rnams gcig tu dril ba yin no/ / gnyis pa ngar 'dzin gyis 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal ba'i tshul ni/ da ni de ltar gzung ba dang 'dzin pas 'khor ba rmi lam lta bu 'dir 'khyams dus sdug bsngal ba'i chu bor bying ba'i rnam pa rnams bshad pa ni/ e ma brtag dka' 'khor ba'i pha mtha' las/ /srid lam dub pa dag gi sdug bsngal ni/ /gang du skyes kyang bde ba 'ga' med de/ /mi dges bskyed pa'i 'bras bu mi bzad pa/ /rang snang log pas rmi lam nang bzhin du/ /'gro drug so sor myong ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /med snang 'khrul pas sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /re zhig mdor bsdus lung bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes pa ste/ lung rnam 'byed las/ mi gtsang 'dam na dri zhim med/ /de bzhin 'gro drug bde ba med/ /'bar ba'i 'obs na bsil ba med/ /srid pa dag na'ang dga' ba med/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis/ 'dod pa nas gzugs su 'pho ba'i srid pa/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa nas 'dod par 'pho ba'i srid pa/ gzugs med nas gzugs su 'pho ba'i srid pa de gsum dang*/ 'gro ba gang du srid pa de dag nas skyes pa'i rigs drug po na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las bde ba'i skabs med do zhes/ re zhig dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la sogs pa'i lung nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad par bya bas rtogs ldan rnams kyi srid pa la dga' ba'i sems bor la thar pa'i chos sgrubs shig ces bskul te/

de ltar ma 'bad na spyir yang 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i phyir te/ slob spring las/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rtag tu 'gyur ba yi/ /nang du zhugs nas bsti ba tsam la bder sems pa/ /de ni nges par dbang med rim gyis brgya phrag tu/ /'gro ba mnyam dang mi mnyam kun du 'khyam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / dbye ba dngos la/ dmyal ba/ yi dgas/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha min/ lha'i sdug bsngal/ de dag las bzlog par gdams pa dang bdun las/ dmyal ba la tsha dmyal dang grang dmyal gnyis te/ tsha dmyal la bcu gnyis kyi/ dang po yang sos ni/ da ni rgyas par dbye ba las/ re zhig yang sos pa dag gi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ yang sos lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng*/ /phan tshun 'dus nas mtshon gyis srog dang 'bral/ /yang sos sgra yis sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba/ /las zad bar du de ltar myong 'tshal lo*/ /de'ang lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng du dmyal ba pa rnams las kyis 'dus te/ dbyug pa dang*/ dgra sta dang*/ mda' bo che dang*/ 'khor lo la sogs pa 'debs res byed pa ni/ dgra bo mi sha bo mthong ba la rgol ba lta bus thams cad shi ba dang*/ nam mkha' las yang sos par gyur cig ces byung ma thag sngar bzhin sos nas mtshon gyis gsod pa'i sdug bsngal la nyin mtshan du lan grangs med pa myong dgos te/ bshes spring las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*/ /'ol yang mi bzod char yang mi phod do/ zhes so/ de'i tshe tshad ni/ tshe'i tshad ni las ma zad kyi bar te/ re zhig thun mong gi mdo sde las 'byung ba bzhin/ tshe tshad mi yi lo grangs lnga bcu la/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha yi nyin zhag gcig /de gnyis sum cu zla ba bcu gnyis lo/ /lnga brgyas yang sos zhag gcig gong 'phel bas/ /rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal brnag dgos so/ /de nyid rab tu dbye ba'i grangs bshad pa/

/mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum drug khri dang*/ /stong phrag gnyis su nges par mdo las gsungs/ /de'ang theg pa chen po thun mong ba'i mdo dang rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams su rang rang gi las srab mthug gis tshe 'pho ba tsam las/ gnas ris der ltung ba rnams tshe tshad gcig tu nges par ma gsungs te/ gnyen po drag po rgyud la skyes pa la sogs pa glo bur du'ang 'pho ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas pa la sogs pa bskal chen du mar gnas dgos par bshad pas/ las kyi sgrib pas phye ba yin te/ bshes spring las/ de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar yin no/ /skabs 'dir theg pa thun mong du grags pa'i dbang du byas te/ mdzod las/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /zhes pa dang*/ dran pa nyer gzhag dang*/ las rnam 'byed du gsungs pa ltar bgrangs na/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i nyin zhag gcig go /de sum cu la zla ba gcig go /de bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya ni/ yang sos pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal te/ mi rnams kyi lor brtsis na/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba yang sos pa dag gis mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag 'bum dang*/ yang drug khri dang*/ stong phrag gnyis kyi bar du thub ste/ zhes so/ / gnyis pa thig nag ni/ de'i 'og na gnas pa'i dmyal ba/ thig nag 'bar ba'i sog les gshags bzhin 'byar/ /'byar bzhin gshog pas shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /mi yi lo brgyar rtsa gsum zhag gcig ste/ /de yi lo stong thig nag zhag gcig la/ /rang lo stong thub mi lo bye ba phrag /sa ya nyis 'bum dgu khri drug stong rtsa/ /bcu gnyis bar du thub par ston pas gsungs/

/ji skad du bshes spring las/ kha gcig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /sta re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis gshags/ /zhes so/ tshe ni mi'i lo brgya la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lo stong thig nag gi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo stong thub ste/ de nyid mi'i lor brtsis na/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ thig nag pa dag gis mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag sa ya nyis 'bum dang*/ yang dgu khri drug stong rtsa bcu gnyis su thub ste zhes so/ / gsum pa bsdus 'joms ni/ de'i 'og na/ bsdus 'joms brag ri rta dang rnga mo dang*// stag dang seng ge la sogs 'dra ba'i bar/ /rdul phran bzhin 'joms gyes pas sngar bzhin 'tsho/ /lcags kyi ljongs su tho bas rdul bzhin 'thag / rab tu btsir bas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa/ /mi lo nyis brgya 'thab bral zhag gcig ste/ /mtshe ma'i nyis stong bsdus 'joms nyin zhag gcig /rang lo stong phrag gnyis su sdug bsngal lo/ /de yang mi lo bye ba phrag sum 'bum/ / drug khri brgyad stong rtsa gcig thub par gsungs/ /ji skad du/ slob spring las/ ri dang mnyam lug ru ring 'jigs su rung pa gnyis/ /'dus pa'i phrag tu lus kun phye mar rlog cing 'joms/ /cung zad bsil ba'i rlung zhig langs pas rtas nas de/ /de bzhin phyir yang lan brgyar kun nas phye mar rlog / ces pa dang*/ bshes spring du/ kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du 'thag par bgyid/ /ces so/ /de'ang 'thab rtsod dang bral bas 'thab bral dang*/ bu dang bu mo gnyis pang nas lhan cig skye bas mtshe ma zhes bya ba'i lha yod de/ mi lo nyis brgya la de'i zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong bsdus 'joms kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo nyis stong thub ste/ mi los dbye na/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ bsdus 'joms pa dag gis mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag sum 'bum dang*/

yang drug khri brgyad stong rtsa gcig gi bar du thub ste zhes so/ / bzhi pa ngu 'bod ni/ de'i 'og na yang*/ ngu 'bod 'bar ba'i mes 'tshig 'o dod 'bod/ /lcags zhun bskol bar 'tshed pas sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bzhi brgya dga' ldan nyin zhag gcig /de yi bzhi stong ngu 'bod zhag gcig ste/ / rang lo bzhi stong bar du sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang*/ /bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri stong dang*/ /bye ba bdun phrag bar du thub pa 'o/ /ji skad du/ bshes spring las/ kha cig mdag me 'bar ba'i tshogs su ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rab bsreg kha yang bgrad/ kha cig lcags zhun bskol ba'i zangs chen du/ /spyi'u tshugs 'bras kyi cung pe bzhin du 'tshed/ /ces pa dang*/ slob spring du/ kha cig 'bru mar bskol ba'i zangs chen nang du lhung*/ /gzhan dag bye ma bsregs pa me stag 'phro ba yi/ /sa gzhi rkang pa bzhag pa'i gnas ma thod par ltung*/ /zhes so/ /de'ang mi lo bzhi brgya la dga' ldan pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i bzhi stong la ngu 'bod kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis nas rang lo bzhi stong thub ste mi'i los bgrangs na/ dran nyer las/ ngu 'bod pa dag gis mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang*/ bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri dang*/ yang stong dang bye ba phrag bdun du thub ste zhes so/ / lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ yang de'i 'og na/ 'bod sgrogs chen po lcags khyim 'bar ba ru/ /'bar ba'i mes bsreg gshin rjes 'tshog par bgyid/ /mi lo brgyad brgya 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig ste/ /de lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod che zhag gcig /rang lo brgyad stong nyid du sdug bsngal nga*/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang*/ /bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong*/ /drug cu rtsa drug bar du thub pa yin/ /ji skad du/ slob spring las/ dmyal me du ba tshe dku 'thul ba mnam pas gnam mdog 'gyur/

/me lce'i lam mang rnam par 'phros pas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor khebs/ /rus gong dkar dum phreng ba'i rgyan gyis sdud pas skyi g.ya' ba/ /glang chen pags gyon sdigs thabs kye ma kyi hud zer ba bzhin/ / la lar me stag cher 'phro 'khrug pa'i 'ur sgra tog yar la/ /zhag gis bab na skad 'ga' bdo ba'i rtse zhil chil chil 'bar/ /brang gi rus pa'i khong du thal nas lhag lhag sgra grags pa/ /bskal pa'i dus kyi me yis bskyad du med pa'i nang du lhung*/ /zhes so/ /mi lo brgyad brgya 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i brgyad stong ngu 'bod chen po'i zhag gcig tu bgrangs pa'i rang lo brgyad stong ste mi'i lor brtsis na/ dran nyer las/ 'bod sgrogs chen pos ni mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang*/ yang bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong dang drug cu rtsa drug gi bar du thub ste zhes so/ / drug pa tsha ba ni/ de'i 'og na/ tsha ba lcags khang nang zhugs mdung thung gis/ / klad pa 'gems shing tho bas rab tu brdung*/ /'bar ba'i me lces phyi nang kun du bsreg /mi'i lo stong du drug brgya gzhan 'phrul zhag /de yi lo khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag /rang lo khri dang drug stong bar thub pa/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang*/ /bzhi 'bum dang ni bye ba khrag khrig phrag /drug stong lnga brgya sum cu snyed mchis so/ /yang*/ slob spring las/ gshin rje'i lag na thog pa dus kyi zhags pa lta'i/ /sbrul gdug mgo 'phang bstod pas dam gzhag gzhungs nas ni/ /

gson por khwa dang bya dkar kāṅka bya rgod kyis/ /der gnas mig dang klad pa tsham tshom par 'bru/ /zhes so/ /mi lo stong phrag drug brgya la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag gcig tu byas te rang lo khri drug stong ste mi'i lor brtsis na/ dran nyer las/ tsha bas ni mi rnams kyi lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang*/ yang bzhi 'bum dang*/ bye ba khrag khrig phrag drug stong lnga brgya dang sum cu'i bar thub ste zhes so/ / bdun pa rab tu tshab ni/ de'i 'og na yang*/ /rab tu tsha ba lcags khyim nyis rim nang*/ /'bar ba'i me dang mdung rtse gsum pas bsnun/ /spyi bo phrag pa gnyis phyung leb mas dkris/ /zangs chen khol mar 'tshed pas sdug bsngal/ /tshe tshad bar gyi bskal pa phyed thub ste/ /mi lo'i grangs kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das/ /'jig rten chags gnas 'jig stongs bskal chung bzhi/ /bar bskal gcig ste brgyad cu bskal chen no/ /de yang*/ mdo las/ gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'bar bas rab tsha ba/ /mdung rtse gsum dang rdo rjes lus bsnun zhing*/ / zangs chen 'bar bar 'tshed cing leb mas dkris/ /phyi nang 'bar ba'i mes 'tshig bsti ba tsam/ /zhes so/ /tshe tshad ni los gzhal bar mi nus pas/ de'ang bskal pa chags 'jig stongs gnas bzhi'i rim pa la bar bskal du brtsis pa'i phyed thub pa ni/ dra nyer las/ rab tu tsha ba dag gis bar gyi bskal pa phyed kyi tshad du sdug bsngal gyi tshor pa des brnag dgos te zhes so/ / brgyad pa mnar med ni/ de'i 'og na/ /mnar med lcags khang me lce 'bar ba'i nang*/ /sems dmyal ku co smre sngags 'don pa las/ /me dang sems can so sor mthong ba med/ /mar me 'bar ba snying po la zhen bzhin/ /srog gi zungs tsam me nang dbus gnas pa/ /bar bskal gnas pa'i yun gcig brnag dgos te/ /de las che ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan med pas/ /mnar med bstir med ces su bshad pa yin/

/ji skad du/ slob spring las/ glo nas rtsa skam snying la sbar ba lta bur me tshogs 'bar/ /mgrin dang kha nas me lce 'bar ba dud bcas bstud mar 'byung*/ khong lto gas pa nas lug nang khrol nar bas kun bred cing*/ /brda mi 'phrod pa'i skad chen 'don pa tsam zhig byed par zad/ /sdug bsngal che las thar par 'dod pa de dag yang nas yang*/ /sgo bye'i gseb gzhan mthong nas thag ring ci zhig blta ste 'byer/ /gang tshe las kyi sgo 'phar dam pos de yang bcad gyur pa/ /de tshe yi mug bzod glags sdug bsngal gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mda' chen rno tshogs 'bar ba char bzhin 'bab pa'i rjes la yang*/ / dmyal ba'i srung mas dbyug pas btab cing mchi ma 'dzag bzhin du/ /lcags zhun khu ba me stag 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa ldud/ kha sna rna ba'i bu ga dag nas dud 'thul gyen du 'phyur/ /mig dang klad spris rdol gyi bar du kun bred cing*/ /klad pa'i rgya la 'bar ba'i me lce smug nag tshogs/ /me de khros pa lta bu de yi lus phung la/ /bud shing skam po bcer la spar ba bzhin du mched/ /ces pa dang*/ bshes spring du/ de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na ni/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzad/ /ces so/ /las rnam dbye las/ mnar med pa'i sgo na lcags kyi ri dpag tshad stong drug khri pa zhig yod de/ de nyid sems can dmyal ba pa dag gis dor bas zad pa na de dag gi tshe 'pho bar yin te dpag tu med do zhes gsungs pa ni las shin tu mthug po chos spangs pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa yin par mngon no/ /dran nyer las/ mnar med pa de dag bar gyi bskal pa de 'das nas tshe 'pho bar 'gyur te/ rgya la mi zhig tu skyes kyang dbang po ma tshang ba dang zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / dgu pa de dag gi don bsdu ba ni/ da ni don bsdu ba/ /gong du smos pa'i dmyal ba de dag kyang*/ /rim bzhin me lce bdun 'gyur gyis tsha la/

/'og mar snga ma'i sdug bsngal lhag dang bcas/ /ji srid las ma zad par sdug bsngal myong*/ / de'ang bshad ma thag pa'i dmyal ba rnams ni me lce bdun 'gyur gyis tshar 'gro ba ste/ rnam 'byed las/ tha mal tsan dan dus mtha' dang*/ /dmyal me rnams kyang go rim bzhin/ /bdun 'gyur gyis ni rab tu tsha/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal bdun phrag 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gnas la/ gong ma gong ma'i sdug bsngal rnams yod bzhin du phyi ma rnams mdze thog tu phol byung ba ltar brtsegs mar ldan zhing*/ tshor ba bdun 'gyur gyis rags pa ltar/ sdug bsngal yang bdun 'gyur gyis che ba yin te las ma zad kyi bar du myong dgos so/ / bcu pa nyi tshe ba la gnyis kyi/ nyi tshe ba dngos bshad pa ni/ de dag gi khongs su 'du ba'i dmyal ba/ nyi tshe ri dang ljon shing nam mkha' dang*/ /brag bar me chu nges med gnas rnams su/ /nyung ngur gnas dang 'dus dang gcig pur gnas/ /der ni sdug bsngal gang rung re res gdung*/ /de phyir nyi tshe ba zhes bshad pa yin/ /'di ltar ri dang*/ brag dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ nam mkha' la sogs pa nges pa med pa'i gnas su nyi tshe ba'i sems can gtun lta bu dang*/ thag pa lta bu dang*/ phyags ma lta bu dang*/ mgal dum lta bu dang*/ sdong dum lta bu dang*/ sems can tha dad pa'i gzugs lta bu du ma 'dus sam/ gcig pur gnas kyang rung ste/ tsha ba dang*/ grang ba dang*/ bkres pa dang*/ skom pa dang*/ gshags pa dang*/ gtub pa dang*/ 'tshed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gang rung re re ni bzod glags med pas nyin mtshan phyed ma'am/ yud tsam mam/ rtag par las kyi len po tha dad pa'i dbang gis gdung bas na nyi tshe ba zhes bya ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ de nas mauṅgal gyi bus rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pa las/ nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba gtun lta bu dang*/ phyags ma lta bu dang*/ ljon shing lta bu rab tu mang po sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa mthong ste smras pa/

srid pa na ni bde ba med/ /nyi tshe ba bzhin 'gro ba kun/ /so so'i sdug bsngal rnams kyis gdung*/ /'bar ba'i khrod na gnas pa 'dra/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ / gzhan gyi 'khrul pa dgag pa la*/ tshul gzhan gyi log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ gzhan dag tshe dang kha cig 'dus pa nyung*/ /de yis nyi tsher 'dod pa 'khrul pa ste/ /brag bar sdigs gzugs tshe yang ring yod la/ /nyi tsher gdugs tshod 'dus pa'i nyan thos gzugs/ /lnga brgya phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs par gsungs/ kha cig ni tshe nyi ma re las med pas nyi tshe ba'o zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ lcags kyi khyim na skyes pa'i rab las/ da dung lo ni mang po zhig /phyir yang dmyal ba 'dir gnas so/ /zhes pas gnod la/ kha cig gcig pur grogs med par ger ba'i phyir nyi tshe ba'o zhes pa'ang ma yin te/ gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ris phyin pa na/ gtsug lag khang dra ba can cig na gaṇḍī brdungs pa las/ nyan thos gyi gzugs lnga brgya 'dug ma thag tu gcig gis gcig la brtsad nas mtshon cha dag gis kha dag par byas so/ /de nas gdugs tshod thob pa'i yun tsam na phyir yang 'ong ba mthong bar lungs las gsungs pas gnod do// bcu gcig pa nye 'khor ba bshad pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ da ni mnar med pa'i dmyal ba'i 'khor lhag po bcu drug gi 'gro ba bshad pa/ nye 'khor mnar med khang pa'i phyi rol bzhir/ /me mar mur dang rol myags mtshon cha'i thang*/ /chu bo rab med bzhi bzhi bcu drug go / gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la drug gi dang po ni/ de yang phyogs gang du phyin yang 'khor ba las/ re zhig me mar mu gyi 'obs ni/ mnar med sgo bye snyam las phyir 'thon pas/ /'obs bzang grib ma mthong nas phyin ma thag /mdag me 'bar ba pus mo nub brgal bas/ /sha kun tshig nas rus pa kunda'i mdog /yang sos sngar bzhin shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /sngar mnar med kyi lcags khang du tsha ba'i sdug bsngal nyen ches pas/

las phal bsrabs pa dang*/ sgo bye ba snyam byed nas bros pas phyir 'thon pa na 'obs bzang po grib ma can 'dra bar mthong zhing lcags kyi khyi dag gis ded pa las/ sdug bsngal bar/ slob spring du/ ral pa'i tshoms mang spungs pas bsgyings pa'i khyi dag gis/ /mche ba gzeng ring rdo rje'i rtse mos lus 'brad cing*/ /chu bo rab med thal skyo me lces gang ba'i ngogs/ /rdo ba zur rdom rtse rnon mi bzad can du bda'/ /zhes so/ /der bying bas sha rus tshig cing yang sos par gyur to/ / gnyis pa ni/ de las thar ba snyam byas nas phyin pa na/ yang ni bsol ba'i 'dam mthong zhugs ma thag /ro myags rul dri nga ba'i 'dam bying nas/ / lcags zangs gser gyi mchu can srin bus 'bigs/ /slob spring las/ kha cig 'bu sbrang phra mo lcig lcig 'dug pa yi/ /tshogs kyis lus rmugs bam zhing rnam par 'drul/ /las kyi rang bzhin rnyi la 'tsho ba thogs pa rnams/ /bskyod pa tsam yang bya bar mi nus bzhin du gson/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa ni/ de nas slar yang thang nyams dga' mthong phyin ma thag /spu gri 'bar bas dum bur gtubs shing 'tsho/ yang*/ de nyin las/ spu gri rno gtams lcug tshal lo ma ral gri yi/ /nang du thang chad brgyugs na lus rmas skyabs med pa/ /rtse gsum mdung thung mda' dang ral gri rnos gang pa'i/ khron pa gshin rje'i kha bas thu ba'i nang du ltung*/ /zhes so/ / bzhi pa ni/ de nas slar yang*/ nags 'dab yid 'ong gang du phyin pa las/ / ral gri'i nags tshal las rlung 'khrug pas bcom/ /ji ltar na/ de nyid las/ nyi tshan gyis gdungs bzod dka' brlag pas skyo ba'i lus/ /ljon shing lo ma sngo stug mthong nas song ba dang*/ /de yi lo ma mtshon brgya lhung bas lus dbang cing*/ /de na yun ring ngud mo las bshes brlag par gnas/ / zhes so/ / lnga pa ni/ yang*/ de 'das ri bor rab tu nyams dga'i rtser/ /sngon gyi yul 'bod mthong ste phyin pa las/

/lcags kyi thur ma rnon pos sha khrag gzags/ /steng du son tshe bya rgod klad pa 'gems/ /slar yang ri yi drung nas 'bod pa snyam/ /'thur du babs pas thur mas gyen du gzags/ /thang mtshams skyes pa bud med mche rnon can/ /'bar bas 'khyud de shin tu sdug bsngal zhing*/ /khyi dang ce sbyang mang pos za bar bgyid/ /de'ang ri rab tu dga' ba snyam pa'i drung du phyin pa na sngon skyes pa dang bud med rang rang gis 'khrig pa'i chos bsten pa'i yul de dang*/ nye du dang 'brel ba mthong nas 'bod pa snyam pa las 'dzegs pa na/ lcags kyi thur mas 'thur du sha khrag gzags shing*/ de bzhin du 'thur la babs pas gyen du gzags nas sdug bsngal ba nyid kyang*/ de nyid las/ shal ma li mtho mi bzad de la myur 'dzegs na/ /tsher ma'i tshogs kha 'thur du bltas pa thal 'byin zhing*/ /zug rngu tshabs po che dag khong rlag nub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/ 'thur du babs na lcags tsher gyen du kha bltas pa/ /rtsub la rno ba mang pos lus phug dran pa nyams/ /de na kha cig mdung rtse gsum pa 'bar ba dang*/ /zug rngu rnon pos lus dbang 'thur du 'bebs mi nus/ /de tshe mtshon cha brdar ba'i mchu can khwa rnams kyis/ /kun du drangs pas rgyu lto brang breng nar zhing 'thor/ kha cig ri bo'i g.yang sa ya ngar g.yang du ltung*/ /zhes pa dang*/ bud med kun nas me lce brgya phrag 'thon pa'i me/ /me stag 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i rgyan gyis bzhugs gyur cing*/ /sog le lta bu rtsub pa'i lus kyis thon med par/ / shin tu sdug pa'i tshul du bcum nas 'khyud par byed/ /ces so/ / drug pa ni/ de nas/ yang ni bsil ba'i chu klung 'bab mthong nas/ /dga' bas song ste rab tu 'bog ma thag /thal tshan rked nub sha rus tshig gyur cing*/ /'gram gnyis gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bar mthong*/ /der ni lo stong mang por sdug bsngal lo/ /ji skad du/ dran nyer las/

de de ltar song ba las/ chu klung gi 'du shes skyes te/ rgal ma thag tu rked pa la thug gu sha rnams kyang tshig /rus pa rnams kyang bye zhing bral ba las slar sos shing 'gram dag na sngon rnam par rtsen pa'i gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bar snang ngo zhes so/ / bcu gnyis pa sdug bsngal de las bzlog par gdams pa ni/ ji skad bstan pa/ tsha ba'i sdug bsngal chen pos gdung ba/ de lta'i dmyal la su zhig 'jigs mi byed/ /srid na de 'dra'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /rang bzhin shes nas 'da' ba'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gdams so/ / grang ba'i dmyal ba la gsum gyis/ dang po grang dmyal brgyad bshad pa ni/ da ni grang ba'i sdug bsngal bshad pa/ grang bas nyam thag pa yang rnam pa brgyad/ /gangs sogs shin tu grang ba'i gnas dag tu/ /mun nag bu yug 'tshubs pas sbrebs pa'i lus/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can/ /grang bas so 'thams smre sngags a chu zer/ /kyi hud utpal ltar gas padma dang*/ /padma che ltar gas pa'i rma nang du/ /srog chags mchu rnon 'bar bas za ba ni/ /ji srid las mtha' gtugs tshe g.yo bar 'gyur/ /gangs dang kha ba'i sbubs grang zhing mun nag dang rlung nag grang mo 'tshubs pas nyen nas/ lus chu bur du rum pa dang*/ chu bur rdol nas rmar song ba dang*/ a chu tsam las smra mi phod pa dang*/ kyi hud ces smra ba dang*/ so 'thams te skad mi thon pa dang*/ rma de dag utpal ltar rtsa ba phra la 'dab ma che bar yod pa phyi nang log pa dang*/ padma ltar bzhi tshal du gas pa dang*/ padma chen po ltar brgyad tshal du gas shing*/ chu rgyus phra mos 'brel ba'i rma nang du srog chags zhugs nas za ba ste/ grang ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa ni/ slob spring las/ lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thing ba yis/ /lus sbrebs 'dar shing bskur nas kum kum por 'dug pa/ /chu bur brgya byung rdol ba las skyes srog chags kyis/ /ral gris dbad nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag

/dkos thag so 'thams skra dang spu rnams g.yengs gyur pa/ /mig dang rna ba lkog ma gnod pas kun gzir cing*/ /lus dang sems kyi bar dag blong blong por gyur nas/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o dod 'bod/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa tshe tshad bshad pa ni/ de ltar sdug bsngal ba brgyad po'i/ tshe yi tshad ni ko sa la yi khal/ /bcu tshan nyi shu shong ba'i til rdzong nas/ /lo brgyar til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can tshe lhag ma nyi shur 'gyur/ /de 'ang*/ dran nyer las/ 'di lta ste grong khyer ko sa la'i bres grangs su bcal ba'i til gyi tshogs bcu tshad nyi shu shong ba'i rdzong pa zhig til gyis bar mtshams med par yongs su gang ste/ chu bur can gyi dmyal ba las lo brgya brgya na til nyag ma re re phyir phyung bas zad par gyur pa de'i tshe/ chu bur can gyi sems can dmyal ba pa de dag tshe 'pho bar rig par bya ste/ gzhan dag ni de las kyang ches lhag pa nyi shus bsgres par sdug bsngal chen po brnag dgos so zhes so/ /de dang mthun par/ mdzod las kyang*/ til rdzong nang nas lo brgya zhing*/ /til gcig phyug bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad do/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur 'gyur/ /

zhes so/ / gsum pa de las thar ba'i thabs la brtson par gdams pa ni/ de ltar tsha ba dang grang ba'i sdug bsngal tshad med pa la bsams te/ sems ldan dag gis sems dmyal 'jig rten las/ /rab tu rgyal phyir brtson pa'i stobs skyed cing*/ /ces 'doms te/ bshes spring las/ sdig can dbugs dbyung 'gag pa tsam zhig gi /dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam stong du/ /mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ / dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang/ /dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang*/ / 'jigs pa skye bar 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ / yi dgas kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa la gsum gyi/ dang po dbyings na gnas pa ni/ da ni yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bstan pa/ yi dgas dbyings mkhar rgyu bas dbyings gnas pa/ lus che rkang lag phra zhing lto ba yang*/ /mgrin pa phra zhing khab kyi mig tsam kha/ /zas skom mi rnyed bkres skom 'bar bas gdungs/ /sman shing me tog la sogs mthong bas bskams/ /phyi rol yid du mi 'ong ngan skyugs za/ /zas skom mthong yang bsrung bar snang ba dang*/ /nang gi sgrib pas lto bar me 'bar zhing*/ kha nas me lce dud par bcas pa 'thul/ /spyi mthun sgrib pas dbul phongs 'jigs sngangs 'tshe/ /nyam nga'i gnas su mgon med sdug bsngal nyen/ /de'ang dbyings na gnas pa las/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni phyi rol yid du mi 'ong bas gang 'dod pa mi thob cing*/ lus ngan la ngan skyugs za zhing zas skom mthong na'ang bsrung bar snang ba'am/ drung du phyin ma thag bskams pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal ba dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can ni de'i steng du'ang lto nas me 'bar zhing du ba 'thul ba dang*/ spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can ni de dag gi steng du'ang spyir khyab par yod pa'i sdug bsngal dbul ba dang*/

phongs pa dang*/ bkres pa dang*/ skom pa dang*/ gzugs mi sdug pa dang*/ dbang po ma tshang ba dang*/ rtag tu gzhan gyis 'tshe bas 'jigs pa dang*/ skyabs dang mgon med pa'o/ /de skad du/ slob spreng las/ mi bzad skom pas rgyang nas chu klung dri med pa/ /mthong nas btung bar 'dod de song na de nyid kyang*/ /skra shad nya lcibs tshogs dang rnag sungs 'dres pa dang*/ /'dam rdzab khrag dang phyi sas gang ba'i chur 'gyur ro/ /dus rlabs rlung langs chu mthor ri rtsa bsil gyur cing*/ /tsandan ljon pa sngo 'khrungs ma la yar song na/ /de yang 'di la nags sreg me lce rnos 'khrigs shing*/ /mgal dum 'gyel ba mang pos rad rod can du 'gyur/ /chu gter rlabs 'jigs 'phang mtho gyes pa las byung ba'i/ /dbu ba btser ba lhag ger 'dug par song na yang*/ /de yang 'di la bye tshan khug rna dmar rtsub pa'i/ /rlung dmar 'jebs par 'tshub pa'i mya ngam nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ni der gnas char sprin ldang bar 'dod na yang*/ /sprin las lcags mda'i char pa dud 'thul mdag mer bcas/ /tsha tsha rdo rje'i pha bong rnam 'phro gser mdog lta'i/ /glog 'phreng dmar ser 'gyu ba lus la char du 'bab/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa mkha' la rgyu ba ni/ phran tshegs pa ni/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dgas 'dre rnams dang*/ /gnod spyin srin po btsan dang rgyal po sogs/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul thogs med kun du rgyu/ /gnod pa sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ /nad gtong mdangs 'phro tshe la bar du gcod/ /tshe tshad mi yi zla bar nyin zhag gcig /rang lo lnga brgya mi lo khri lnga stong*/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag tu sdug bsngal lo/ /'di dag kyang yi dgas kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa'i phyir bsdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ yul yid du mi 'ong ba dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ nyam nga ba dang*/ bkres skom dang*/ gang du snying nye nas phyin pa de dag tu'ang sngon 'chi ka'i gnad gcod kyi nad de pha rol la 'go ba dang*/
